purpose: Reusable teaching pattern, not a visual clone
objective: Explain how a token obtains a context-aware representation through self-attention.

conceptualBeats.intent: Start from tokens/representations the learner recognizes.
Separate query, key and value roles with stable identity.
Make the comparison operation and score matrix spatially explicit.
Show scores becoming normalized attention weights.
Use attention weights to combine values.
Reconnect the computation to the resulting representation.

requiredRelationships: softmax converts a row of scores into weights
the weighted values combine into an output representation
visualRealizationIsFreeToVary: animation timing within the Learn motion grammar
